issues.description: Numeric threshold in the solution for Aufgabe 06 does not match the requirement in the problem statement. The problem asks for Gemeinden with more than 100,000 male and more than 100,000 female inhabitants ("mehr als 100.000"), but solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql uses 10000 (ten thousand) as the threshold (WHERE einwohner_m > 10000 AND einwohner_w > 10000). This mismatch will produce a different result set and mislead students about the correct condition.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the numeric thresholds in solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql to match the problem statement. For example, update the WHERE clause to: WHERE einwohner_m > 100000 AND einwohner_w > 100000. Ensure any explanatory comments or tests reflect the 100,000 threshold as well.
